skins.label: Everyday restaurant (generic + pan-Asian + fusion)
skins.photo_slots: dish close-up -> hero and first 6 menu cards; interior -> atmosphere strip; people/staff -> about; exterior -> visit block
skins.palette_schemes: TonalSpot default; Neutral if calm; Vibrant if street. Follows the personality scheme unchanged.
skins.type_bias: Follows personality (T1/T4 cosy, T2/T6 street, T3/T5 premium). No skin bias.
skins.voice: Plain, warm, specific: say what they cook and where.
skins.menu_shape: By category as the business lists it (starters, mains, drinks); flat list when under ~15 items.
skins.price_source: Board photo or delivery app (Grab/ShopeeFood in VN, LINE MAN in Bangkok); if neither, show dishes without prices.
skins.why_grouped: The catch-all rows (Restaurant, Asian, Fusion, Eclectic, Western). No cuisine to lean on, so personality does all the work; this skin is the neutral baseline.

skins.label: Coffee house (coffee shop, stand, store)
skins.photo_slots: drink close-up -> hero and drink cards; interior seating -> atmosphere; counter/barista -> about; menu board -> menu fallback
skins.palette_schemes: TonalSpot or Fidelity (browns, creams) for cosy; Vibrant for street stands; Monochrome for specialty/premium.
skins.ground: light cream ground by default; dark for evening-leaning interiors
skins.type_bias: T1 (warm serif) for cosy; T4 for playful; T2 for street stands.
skins.voice: Slow and sensory: the drink, the seat, the hour.

phrases.en: Find us in {area}, have a cup

skins.extra_slot: none (optional: wifi/work-friendly badge only if reviews say it)
skins.menu_shape: By drink type (coffee, tea, smoothie, food), sizes as variants.
skins.price_source: Board photo most common; Grab/ShopeeFood listing second.

references.note: specialty coffee, photo-led product pages (reasoned; page not fetched)

skins.why_grouped: Vietnam-style coffee shops: drink-led, seating mood, signature drinks (cà phê muối, bạc xỉu). Merges coffee shop/stand/store/vending (same menu logic).

skins.label: Cafe and brunch (cafe, brunch, breakfast, pancake)
skins.photo_slots: plated dish -> hero; interior -> second hero or collage; drinks -> menu cards; people -> about
skins.palette_schemes: TonalSpot, Expressive for playful; FruitSalad if colourful plating.
skins.type_bias: T1 or T4 (rounded, friendly). T5 for minimal brunch spots.
skins.voice: Bright and easy: the table, the light, the plate.
skins.menu_shape: By daypart (breakfast, brunch, drinks, sweet) then category.
skins.price_source: Board photo or app; small menus often fully typed from photos.
skins.why_grouped: Food plus coffee, daytime. Brunch/breakfast/pancake have the same visual logic as cafe (plated food in daylight).

skins.label: Thai restaurant
skins.photo_slots: dish close-up -> hero; open wok or street counter -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Expressive (chilli red, lime, gold); Fidelity for premium dining rooms.
skins.ground: light for street; dark for premium
skins.type_bias: T6 or T2 for street; T3 for premium; Thai script needs a Thai-capable fallback (not in T1–T6 guarantee: add to type check).
skins.voice: Direct and flavour-first; heat level is a feature.

phrases.vi: {dish} cay vừa hoặc cay nhiều, tại {name}
phrases.en: {dish}, made to your spice level, at {name}

phrases.vi: Ăn tại chỗ hoặc mang đi: {hours}

skins.extra_slot: Spice-level selector on dish cards (only when the menu data lists it); else none.
skins.menu_shape: By dish type (curries, stir-fries, noodles, rice, salads); sets for groups.
skins.price_source: Delivery app (LINE MAN/Grab) in Bangkok; board photo for street.
skins.why_grouped: The 4th largest single row, almost all Bangkok. Thai in Bangkok means everything from street stalls to dinner rooms; skin leans on dish colour and heat.

skins.label: Bar, pub and nightlife (bar, pub, bar and grill, brewery, sports, queer, salsa)
skins.photo_slots: night interior -> hero; taps/drinks -> menu cards; crowd/event -> events strip; exterior sign -> visit
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Rainbow on dark; Expressive for playful venues.
skins.type_bias: T2 or T6 (condensed, loud); T4 if playful.
skins.voice: Short, loud, specific: what is on tonight.
skins.extra_slot: Happy hour + events strip (only if hours/events exist in data); else none.
skins.menu_shape: By drink type (beer, cocktails, spirits, bites); bar bites last.
skins.why_grouped: Beer-and-night venues. Cocktail/wine/lounge split off because they are premium and photo-led; this group is volume and events.

skins.label: Fast food, burgers and fried chicken
skins.photo_slots: product shot -> hero; combo shots -> menu cards; counter/exterior -> visit
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Rainbow (primary red/yellow); Expressive for playful.
skins.voice: Fast: item, price, order.
skins.extra_slot: Delivery-first: order buttons (Grab/ShopeeFood/LINE MAN/own phone) above the fold; menu below.
skins.menu_shape: By combos then single items then sides/drinks.
skins.price_source: Delivery app almost always: pull prices from it.

references.note: burger brand; order-first (403 to curl, not read)

skins.why_grouped: Delivery-first formats: fast food, fried chicken, burgers, fish and chips (takeaway). The site is a menu plus an order button.

skins.label: Local eatery / diner (diner, cơm quán, family, lunch, takeout)
skins.photo_slots: plate/tray -> hero; counter display -> menu; frontage -> visit (people find these by the street)
skins.palette_schemes: TonalSpot, Neutral; Vibrant for loud street spots.
skins.type_bias: T5 or T6; T1 for family feel.
skins.voice: Home-cooked and daily: what is on today.
skins.extra_slot: Daily specials strip only if the owner supplies it; else none.
skins.menu_shape: By set/plate then sides; rotating daily.
skins.price_source: Board photo, hand-written menu board (needs OCR); few apps.
skins.why_grouped: Surprising: "Diner" (3,760) in Vietnam and Thailand is the neighbourhood eatery (rice plates, set lunches), not an American diner. Merges family, lunch, rice, porridge, takeout, meal delivery.

skins.label: Noodle house (ramen, udon, soba, Chinese noodles, soup)
skins.photo_slots: bowl -> hero and each menu card; open kitchen/counter -> about; counter seats -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Fidelity; Monochrome for premium ramen bars.
skins.ground: dark for ramen/izakaya feel; light for Chinese noodle
skins.type_bias: T2 or T6 (condensed/heavy); T3 for premium.
skins.voice: Broth-first, minimal: base, bowl, extras.
skins.extra_slot: Base + toppings builder (only if toppings listed); else none.
skins.menu_shape: By base/broth, then toppings and sides.
skins.price_source: Board photo or app; fixed bowl prices common.
skins.why_grouped: Merged on one logic: a bowl hero, a short menu by base/broth, toppings as modifiers. Ramen is the largest row (3,073). Pho stays in Vietnamese because its site looks and sounds different.

skins.label: Vietnamese restaurant (incl. pho, country food)
skins.photo_slots: dish -> hero; table scene -> atmosphere; ingredients -> about
skins.type_bias: T1 or T5; diacritics are the first check (full Vietnamese).
skins.voice: Home and place: the dish, the region, the family.
skins.menu_shape: By dish type (khai vị, món chính, canh, cơm, đồ uống).
skins.why_grouped: Local cuisine in DN and HCM. Includes pho and country food (món quê) because the table and the menu logic are the same.

skins.label: Bakery and pastry
skins.photo_slots: display case -> hero; product close-ups -> cards; baker -> about
skins.palette_schemes: TonalSpot or Content (warm neutrals); Expressive for cake shops.
skins.voice: Fresh and made-by-hand: the bake, the hour.

phrases.en: Out of the oven daily at {bake_time}

skins.extra_slot: Pre-order form for cakes (date, size, message), only if the business takes custom orders.
skins.menu_shape: By product (bread, pastry, cake) with a custom-order section.
skins.price_source: Board photo, Facebook posts, sometimes Zalo.
skins.why_grouped: Case-led: photos of the display. Pre-order cakes is the money slot.

skins.label: Bubble tea and drink stand
skins.photo_slots: cup shots -> hero and cards; counter -> about; menu board -> OCR source
skins.voice: Playful and short: flavour names, sizes.
skins.extra_slot: Toppings builder (size, sugar, ice, toppings) if the menu has toppings.
skins.menu_shape: By drink type (milk tea, fruit tea, cheese foam, smoothies) + toppings list.
skins.price_source: Delivery app most often; board photo for stands.
skins.why_grouped: Order-and-go with toppings: a builder UI more than a menu. 2,576 no-site, mostly HCM and Bangkok.

skins.label: Japanese (restaurant, regional, donburi, tonkatsu, tempura, curry, teishoku)
skins.photo_slots: plated dish -> hero; chef/kitchen -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Monochrome or Fidelity (ink, wood, one red accent); Neutral for calm.
skins.ground: light for casual; dark for ryotei/kaiseki
skins.type_bias: T3 or T5; T1 for casual. Needs Japanese-capable fallback if the owner uses kanji.
skins.voice: Precise and quiet: ingredient, technique, season.
skins.extra_slot: Set menus (course price, what is included) when the data has sets.
skins.menu_shape: By dish family (don, katsu, tempura, sets) with sets first.
skins.price_source: Board or delivery app; set menus on a photo.
skins.why_grouped: All the Japanese sit-down formats except sushi, noodles and izakaya. Menu is by dish family; the photo story is plated dishes and clean interiors.

skins.label: Dessert and ice cream
skins.photo_slots: macro shot -> hero; flavour tubs -> cards; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Expressive, FruitSalad; Content for pastel shops.
skins.voice: Sweet and visual: names of flavours, not adjectives.
skins.extra_slot: Toppings/flavour builder when the data has toppings.
skins.menu_shape: By product (cup, cone, sundae) then toppings/flavours.
skins.why_grouped: Dessert shops, ice cream, sundae, chè/cendol, chocolate cafe. Same macro-shots of sweet things and a flavour list.

skins.label: Chinese (regional, dim sum, dumplings, delivery)
skins.photo_slots: dish -> hero; group table -> atmosphere; dumpling/dim sum steamers -> gallery
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Fidelity (red/gold); Monochrome for upscale.
skins.ground: light for casual; dark for banquet
skins.type_bias: T3 for upscale; T6/T5 for casual. Needs Chinese-capable fallback if the owner supplies it.
skins.voice: Generous and shared: dishes for the table.
skins.extra_slot: Group booking (party size, date) when the venue has large tables.
skins.menu_shape: By category and numbered dishes; set menus for groups.
skins.why_grouped: Chinese incl. Cantonese, dim sum, dumplings, Taiwanese and the sub-regional cuisines. Menu is long and numbered; round-table groups matter.

skins.label: Seafood
skins.photo_slots: catch/tank -> hero; cooked dish -> cards; seating by the sea -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Fidelity (sea blue, coral); TonalSpot.
skins.voice: Fresh today, priced by weight.

phrases.vi: Hải sản tươi sống, giá theo {unit}

skins.extra_slot: Price-by-weight table / live-catch list only if prices exist; else none.
skins.menu_shape: By seafood type (fish, crab, shrimp, shellfish) then cooking method.
skins.price_source: Board photo; prices change daily so mark them as a guide.
skins.why_grouped: Seafood restaurants in DN/HCM and Bangkok are price-by-weight and tank-led. The photo of the tank or catch is the hero.

skins.label: Vegetarian, healthy and organic
skins.photo_slots: bowl -> hero; ingredients -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.voice: Calm and honest: ingredients, no promises about health.
skins.extra_slot: none (dietary tags only if on the menu)
skins.menu_shape: By meal type; products by shelf for stores.
skins.why_grouped: Strong in VN (Buddhist vegetarian) and Bangkok; includes health food stores and organic food stores as product lists.

skins.label: Indian and South Asian (incl. halal, haleem, biryani, Pakistani)
skins.photo_slots: curry -> hero; tandoor -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Expressive (saffron, red); Fidelity for premium.
skins.type_bias: T6 or T1; Devanagari fallback optional.
skins.voice: Rich and warm: spice, tandoor, the table.
skins.extra_slot: Delivery-first when an app listing exists; halal badge only if the data says so.
skins.menu_shape: By course (starters, curries, breads, biryani).
skins.why_grouped: 38 rows folded together because the site pattern is the same: curry-and-bread menu, halal cue, delivery. Halal and haleem are the biggest rows.

skins.label: Steakhouse and meat dishes (steak, chophouse)
skins.photo_slots: steak -> hero; interior -> atmosphere; grill -> about
skins.voice: Confident and plain: cut, weight, temperature.
skins.menu_shape: By course; steaks by cut and weight.
skins.why_grouped: Dinner, premium, sometimes group. Photos of cuts and interiors.

skins.label: Korean (non-BBQ)
skins.photo_slots: stew -> hero; banchan -> gallery; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Rainbow; Expressive for playful.
skins.type_bias: T6 or T4; Korean fallback is already required by the engine.
skins.voice: Hearty, sharing, hot.
skins.menu_shape: By dish type (stews, rice, noodles, sets).
skins.why_grouped: Korean stews, rice, fried chicken, soondae. BBQ is its own skin; this one is stews and one-dish meals.

skins.label: Tea house
skins.photo_slots: tea service -> hero; interior -> atmosphere; leaves -> about
skins.voice: Calm and unhurried.
skins.menu_shape: By tea type (green, oolong, black), with a short snack list.
skins.why_grouped: Quiet tea rooms. Different from bubble tea: calm, ritual, slower.

skins.label: Sandwich, deli and snack (incl. bánh mì style)
skins.photo_slots: product -> hero; counter -> about; packaging -> gallery
skins.voice: Grab-and-go, honest: fillings.
skins.menu_shape: By item then fillings/sides.
skins.why_grouped: Counter-led takeaway: items by filling, order-ahead for offices.

skins.label: Cocktail, wine and lounge
skins.photo_slots: drink -> hero; interior -> atmosphere; bartender -> about
skins.voice: Understated and precise: the pour, the room.
skins.menu_shape: By drink type (signature, classic, wine, bites).
skins.why_grouped: Premium bars: photo-led, dark, reservations.

skins.label: BBQ and grill (Korean BBQ, yakiniku, barbecue, satay, mutton, offal BBQ)
skins.photo_slots: grill shot -> hero; platters -> cards; group -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Vibrant or Fidelity (charcoal, ember); Rainbow for loud spots.
skins.voice: Fire and sharing: platters, groups, table.
skins.menu_shape: By set/platter then by meat/seafood then sides.
skins.price_source: Board photo; sets often on the board.
skins.why_grouped: Table grills. The site sells the group night: the grill photo, the meat platter, the table.

skins.label: Sushi (restaurant, conveyor, temaki)
skins.photo_slots: nigiri -> hero; counter/chef -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.palette_schemes: Monochrome or Neutral (ink, cedar); Vibrant for conveyor.
skins.ground: light for casual; dark for omakase
skins.type_bias: T3 or T5; T6 for conveyor.
skins.voice: Precise and respectful: fish, rice, hands.
skins.extra_slot: Omakase/set-menu card (courses, price, seats, booking), only when the data has it.
skins.menu_shape: By set (omakase, nigiri sets) then à la carte.
skins.why_grouped: Sushi is the Japanese skin that earns its own: omakase and set menus change the booking slot.

skins.label: Pizzeria (pizza, pizza delivery, Neapolitan)
skins.photo_slots: pizza -> hero and cards; oven -> about; interior -> atmosphere
skins.voice: Hot and fast: size, toppings, order.

phrases.en: Wood oven, baked on the spot

skins.extra_slot: Delivery-first: order buttons above the fold; size + toppings builder if data allows.
skins.menu_shape: By pizza type then sides/drinks.
skins.why_grouped: Delivery-first, with a sit-down variant. Decide by delivery links in the data.

skins.label: Karaoke / KTV
skins.photo_slots: room -> hero; lighting -> atmosphere; menu -> cards
skins.voice: Loud and bookable: rooms, hours, packages.
skins.extra_slot: Room booking (size, hour) - closer to booking module than menu; flag it.
skins.menu_shape: By room type + drinks and snacks.
skins.why_grouped: A room-booking business wearing a bar menu. 753 no-site.

skins.label: Buffet and self-service
skins.photo_slots: spread -> hero; hall -> atmosphere
skins.voice: Generous and clear: price per head, what is included.
skins.menu_shape: By session (lunch/dinner) with a price table.
skins.why_grouped: Price-per-head: the offer is the page (price, hours, what is included).

skins.label: Juice and smoothie
skins.photo_slots: cup -> hero; fruit -> about; board -> OCR
skins.voice: Fresh and plain: fruit names.
skins.menu_shape: By drink type + add-ons.
skins.why_grouped: Fruit-led drink counter; close to bubble tea but healthy.

skins.label: Italian (trattoria, regional)
skins.photo_slots: pasta -> hero; interior -> atmosphere; bar -> about
skins.voice: Warm and generous: pasta, wine, the table.
skins.menu_shape: By course (antipasti, pasta, mains, dolci).
skins.why_grouped: Dine-in Italian (not pizza-first). Menu by course; wine list matters.

skins.label: Middle Eastern and Mediterranean (excl. kebab)
skins.photo_slots: mezze -> hero; grill -> about
skins.voice: Sharing and generous.
skins.menu_shape: By course (mezze, grills, mains).
skins.why_grouped: Turkish, Lebanese, Mediterranean, Greek, Persian and neighbours; mezze-sharing.

skins.label: Latin American and Caribbean
skins.photo_slots: plate -> hero; drinks -> cards
skins.voice: Bright and social.
skins.menu_shape: By course and sharing plates.
skins.why_grouped: 33 rows (Mexican, Brazilian, Peruvian...). Small but colourful; one site pattern.

skins.label: European bistro and fine dining
skins.photo_slots: plate -> hero; interior -> atmosphere
skins.voice: Quiet and craft: ingredient, region, season.
skins.extra_slot: Tasting-menu card + reservations when data has it.
skins.menu_shape: By course; tasting menu on top.
skins.why_grouped: 49 rows: French, German, Spanish, British, Nordic, fine dining. The only skins that lean premium by default.

skins.label: Themed cafe (animal, comic, cosplay, art, internet)
skins.photo_slots: theme -> hero; people -> about
skins.voice: Playful and rule-clear (hours, entry, house rules).
skins.menu_shape: By drinks with an entry/price block.
skins.why_grouped: Experience is the product; the drinks are secondary.

skins.label: American and comfort (regional US, Canadian, Cajun, Southern)
skins.photo_slots: plate -> hero
skins.voice: Generous and casual.
skins.menu_shape: By course.
skins.why_grouped: Small total; all comfort-food formats with the same site.

skins.label: Southeast Asian regional (Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Singaporean, Burmese)
skins.photo_slots: dish -> hero; stall -> about
skins.voice: Flavour and place.
skins.menu_shape: By dish type.
skins.why_grouped: Indonesian regional rows are numerous but tiny; Singapore/Malaysia near-duplicates.

skins.label: Kebab and shawarma (doner, gyro, durum, kofta)
skins.photo_slots: wrap -> hero; spit -> about
skins.voice: Fast and hungry.
skins.menu_shape: By wrap/plate then sides.
skins.why_grouped: Delivery-first, counter-led; skewer-and-wrap.

skins.label: African restaurant
skins.photo_slots: plate -> hero
skins.voice: Warm and communal.
skins.menu_shape: By dish type and sharing platters.
skins.why_grouped: Small and varied: West, East, Ethiopian, Cape Verdean.

skins.label: Hotpot (hot pot, steamboat, shabu, sukiyaki)
skins.photo_slots: pot -> hero; platters -> cards
skins.voice: Bubbling and shared.

phrases.en: Choose a broth, choose your dips

skins.extra_slot: By-the-pot builder (broth + items), if the menu has the structure.
skins.menu_shape: By broth then items/platters then sauces.
skins.why_grouped: By-the-pot with broth + items; zero no-site in the four cities as matched, but a distinct site shape.

skins.label: Izakaya and yakitori (incl. kushiyaki, kushikatsu)
skins.photo_slots: skewers -> hero
skins.voice: Late and sociable.
skins.menu_shape: By skewer/plate, then drinks.
skins.why_grouped: Small plates and drinks, dark rooms, group nights.

skins.label: Not a menu business (misrouted by INDEX.csv)
skins.photo_slots: route to booking skins
skins.voice: n/a
skins.menu_shape: n/a
skins.why_grouped: Ten rows tagged "Menu" in INDEX.csv that are services or retail: hair removal, weight loss, beautician, hairdresser, eyebrow bar, karaoke equipment rental, indoor golf, frozen food. Route them to services + booking (or retail). Zero no-site count anyway.
